chose: the coverage reading at an edit reads only the components holding the written files, whose contexts it reads whole; specs, practice files and run files are parsed once and kept under .coherence/cache while their stat stands, so an edit and a command pay for what changed, and the work meter counts reads, spawns, readings, spec model loads, server requests and phrase comparisons per hook call
over: keep reading the whole corpus and the whole spec model at every write; or drop the vocabulary line at the edit until the deadline-aware deferral exists
because: an edit's cost must be its own component's, independent of the others; a scoped reading keeps sense-at-risk exact for the edited component and only defers a term whose recurrence spans other components to the next prompt and the stop, which read in full; the deferral design (d-45f0a5f4) is queued behind this meter
